title: Short Sleeve Cotton Bodysuit - Harmonious
sourceText: Designed to go with everything, Harmonious is the perfect chocolate brown neutral. Super soft and breathable cotton is the base of the Snag Short Sleeve Bodysuit. We wanted to start with an awesome fabric that will not only look amazing, but will last too. The short sleeves that hit just above the elbow and scoop neckline give this a classic silhouette and the popper fastening at the gusset has been fitted on so many different body types, to make sure it is long enough and stretchy enough to be comfy and strong enough to stay fastened all day. It's super stretchy, but sits against the body without cutting in, no uncomfortable underarms or thighs here. There is extra bust support built in, with an elasticated band that sits beneath the bust to give enough support that you don't need to wear a bra (but you can if you want to). This is the perfect addition to your capsule wardrobe and looks amazing with a Snag Flare Skirt, Mom Jeans or even with Dance Tights for your next lesson.

title: Amelia Aviator Jacket - Brown
sourceText: Get ready to fall head over heels for the Amelia Aviator Jacket in Brown faux fur. This longer-line aviator is crafted from smooth vegan PU faux leather in the most delicious deep brown, then lined from collar to hem in the softest, cosiest faux fur we have ever created. One touch and you will understand why this feels like pure luxury wrapped around you. Hook-and-eye closures march down the front for a sleek, polished finish, while clever darting flatters the bust and gently celebrates every curve. Silver buckles at the hem, gleaming zipped pockets (so roomy you can lose your gloves in them) and that signature metal back-neck chain add just the right amount of rock-glam swagger. The woven fabric has no stretch and comes in single sizes so you get that perfect, tailored-to-you fit with generous room to layer thick knits underneath when winter really bites. Wear it over a velvet dress for unstoppable party-season glamour. Throw it on with denim and boots for coffee with friends. Or let it elevate your everyday coat game. This is the jacket that makes you walk taller, feel expensive and turn heads without even trying. An heirloom piece you will treasure and reach for year after year. title: Denim Shorts - Atlantic
sourceText: First we transformed jeans forever. Now meet the Atlantic Denim Shorts, built from the same bestselling Snag Denim fit that customers fell in love with. The super soft fabric is cleverly cut in 18 sizes to be comfortable, custom-fit denim designed to move with your body instead of fighting against it. No stiff fabric, no awkward waistband gaps, no digging in by lunchtime. Made in a timeless mid-blue wash, Atlantic is your classic denim colourway that goes with absolutely everything. The high-waisted fit sits comfortably and smoothly against the body, while the mid-upper thigh length makes them perfect for everyday wear, summer adventures and layering with fishnets or tights when the weather cools down. Crafted from super-soft organic cotton with just a hint of stretch, finished with five practical pockets and developed through years of fit testing and wearer trials, these are denim shorts designed to actually be lived in. Layer them with our Ravish or Cecelia Payne fishnets when the sun goes down, the denim-and-fishnet combo is a festival look that earns its place. Made with 99% organic cotton and finished using our innovative denim process that uses 75% less water than traditional techniques. title: Period Pants – Black
sourceText: Meet Period Pants, knickers with built-in period protection in three flows: Light, Medium and Heavy, so you can pick what suits your day instead of reaching for a one-size-fits-all pad. This is our first product in this category, launched as a trial, and we genuinely want your feedback to help shape where we take it next. They're built on our bestselling Full Brief Knickers, with four specialist layers doing the work instead of our usual two. They'll feel a touch more padded than our regular knickers, simply because the protection is doing its job, but they stay soft, flexible and comfortable to wear all day. It's been over two years in development, wearer-tested by real people during real periods across all three flows, and fit tested across our full, inclusive UK 4 to 38 range, because period protection that only fits some bodies isn't protection at all. Why You'll Love Them 🖤 Classic black period pants, discreet enough for every day. 💧 Three flows to choose from: Light (20ml), Medium (40ml) or Heavy (60ml). 🩲 Wear on their own, just like ordinary knickers, with absorbency built in. 🛡️ Four specialist layers work together to wick moisture away, absorb it, block leaks and stay breathable. 🤗 Familiar full-coverage fit, based on our bestselling Full Brief Knickers. 🌈 Inclusively sized UK 4 to 38. ♻️ Reusable and washable. Wear, wash, wear again. 🧪 Over two years in development, wearer-tested during real periods and made with OEKO-TEX ® standard certified fabrics that are tested free from PFAS.

title: Bamboo Lounge Shorts - Black
sourceText: Our bamboo fabric is absolute magic. You have to touch it to believe it. Super soft and lightweight on the skin, with a cool, satin touch and a liquid-like drape. And with it we’ve made the perfect everyday shorts you’ll wear on repeat all year round. Made from bamboo stretch jersey, they feel incredibly soft, smooth and almost weightless against your skin. The fabric is naturally cooling to the touch, pulls moisture away from your body, and keeps air moving so you stay fresh instead of sticky or clammy. They are, also, completely opaque, drape beautifully and move with you, giving that calm, confident feeling, even on the hottest or most hectic days. Pull them on for a full day of chasing toddlers in the park, pottering in the garden, doing the weekly shop, or binge-watching your favourite show on the sofa. You can even wear them to sleep and banish the dreaded night sweats! The length sits at a flattering mid-to-lower thigh, the deep flat side pockets hold your phone, keys and bits without adding any bulk to your hips, and the adjustable tie waist keeps them exactly where you want them all day or night. They look put-together enough to wear out but feel like pyjamas at home. At Snag, we fit-test on real bodies from UK 4 to 38, so they actually fit comfortably, stay put and look great, wash after wash. All our products are made ethically and sustainably so doing something good for you also does good for others and for the planet. title: Debbie Off-Shoulder Tee - NOM-NOM Shark Print
sourceText: Dun-dun… dun-dun… but make it cute. The Debbie Tee is back in our Nom Nom Shark print, featuring a cheeky shark popping up with one thing on its mind… snack time. With bold blues and teals and a punchy mustard yellow “Nom Nom” thought bubble, this design by Sophie is playful, silly and guaranteed to get a teethy grin. Throw it on with jeans, style it with a skirt, or clash it with prints if you’re feeling dangerous. Looks aside, this tee is all about easy, throw-on comfort that still feels thoughtful and considered. title: Noor Cotton Gauze Wide-Leg Trousers - Brown
sourceText: These are the wide-leg trousers you'll wish you'd packed twice. Rich, earthy Brown brings warmth to every outfit and pairs beautifully with the matching wrap top. Made from beautifully soft double cotton gauze, these cotton gauze trousers are lightweight, breathable and naturally crinkled, so they always look effortlessly relaxed. The deep shirred waistband moves with you, gently defining your waist while staying comfortable all day, and the soft gauze legs fall into an easy, flowing silhouette. Wear them high waisted or lower on the hips, and fill the deep pockets with your essentials. It's ethically and sustainably made in India and available in Snag's inclusive sizes, 4 to 38. Every piece in our Woven Winds range is named after a woman who changed history, in homage to the legendary Dhaka muslin fabric once known as “woven air” for how weightlessly it moved. These trousers take their name from Noor Inayat Khan, the Sufi princess and children's author who became the first female wireless operator the UK sent into occupied France during the Second World War. Why You'll Love Them 🤎 Super soft 100% double cotton gauze that's lightweight, breathable and perfect for warm weather. ☁️ Naturally crinkled fabric means no worrying about ironing. ✨ Deep shirred waistband that moves comfortably with you. 💕 Wear high waisted or lower on the hips to suit your style. 🌿 Soft, flowing wide-leg trousers that skim your shape without clinging. 👜 Deep side pockets for all your essentials. 👗 Pairs perfectly with the matching cotton gauze wrap top or your favourite Snag staples. 📏 Easy, relaxed fit designed for all-day comfort. 🧵 Fit tested on real bodies in inclusive UK sizes 4 to 38. 🌍 Ethically and sustainably made in India.

title: Short Sleeve Cotton Bodysuit - Sangria
sourceText: Pour yourself a glass of confidence with Sangria, our rich and vibrant red bodysuit. Super soft and breathable cotton is the base of the Snag Short Sleeve Bodysuit. We wanted to start with an awesome fabric that will not only look amazing, but will last too. The short sleeves that hit just above the elbow and scoop neckline give this a classic silhouette and the popper fastening at the gusset has been fitted on so many different body types, to make sure it is long enough and stretchy enough to be comfy and strong enough to stay fastened all day. It's super stretchy, but sits against the body without cutting in, no uncomfortable underarms or thighs here. There is extra bust support built in, with an elasticated band that sits beneath the bust to give enough support that you don't need to wear a bra (but you can if you want to). This is the perfect addition to your capsule wardrobe and looks amazing with a Snag Flare Skirt, Mom Jeans or even with Dance Tights for your next lesson.

title: Claudette Trousers - Black
sourceText: You want freedom, well make it flattering. Our Claudette Trousers in black are designed for days when comfort is non-negotiable but you still want to feel effortlessly put together. Soft, loose and beautifully airy, these jersey trousers move with you through lounging, woodland walks, yoga stretches and everything in between. They are light, breathable and cooling on the skin, giving you that barely-there feeling while still looking polished enough for the outside world. Cut with a relaxed drape that flatters every body, these trousers feature a deep stretch waistband that smooths the tummy, cinches the waist and stays put without digging in or rolling down. Tried, tested and loved by real humans, the waistband is designed to work with you, not against you. Deep side pockets keep your essentials close, while the fabric flows down to gather neatly at the ankle with a comfy elasticated cuff. Made from LENZING™ ECOVERO™ viscose, a sustainable fabric derived from certified renewable wood sources, these are slow-fashion staples created to support you through life’s ups, downs and everything in between. Why You’ll Love It 🖤 Soft, loose boho fit that feels free and unencumbered 🌬️ Lightweight LENZING™ ECOVERO™ jersey that is cooling and naturally breathable ✨ Deep 6cm stretch waistband that smooths, flatters and never digs in 🧘 Wearer-tested waistband that will not roll, flip or slide down 👜 Deep side pockets for phone, keys and daily essentials 🔀 Relaxed drape with elasticated ankle cuffs for easy movement 👖 Looks smarter than sweats but feels just as comfy 🧼 Designed to last wash after wash without losing shape 📏 Inclusive sizing so every body is welcome 🌍 Ethically made in Turkey as part of a slow-fashion approach Every product in the Untamed Soul range is named in honour of someone who refused to accept the boundaries and limits that society put on them. These trousers are named after Claudette Colvin, who was just 15 years old when she refused to give up her seat to a white passenger on a segregated bus in Montgomery, Alabama—nine months before Rosa Parks did the same. Despite her bravery, civil rights leaders at the time felt an unmarried pregnant teenager wasn't the right face for the movement, so her story was largely pushed to the margins. We honour Claudette because she reminds us of the raw, unfiltered courage of youth and the uncomfortable truth that history often polishes away the edges of the people who actually started the fire.

title: Claudette Trousers - Black
sourceText: You want freedom, well make it flattering. Our Claudette Trousers in black are designed for days when comfort is non-negotiable but you still want to feel effortlessly put together. Soft, loose and beautifully airy, these jersey trousers move with you through lounging, woodland walks, yoga stretches and everything in between. They are light, breathable and cooling on the skin, giving you that barely-there feeling while still looking polished enough for the outside world. Cut with a relaxed drape that flatters every body, these trousers feature a deep stretch waistband that smooths the tummy, cinches the waist and stays put without digging in or rolling down. Tried, tested and loved by real humans, the waistband is designed to work with you, not against you. Deep side pockets keep your essentials close, while the fabric flows down to gather neatly at the ankle with a comfy elasticated cuff. Made from LENZING™ ECOVERO™ viscose, a sustainable fabric derived from certified renewable wood sources, these are slow-fashion staples created to support you through life’s ups, downs and everything in between. Why You’ll Love It 🖤 Soft, loose boho fit that feels free and unencumbered 🌬️ Lightweight LENZING™ ECOVERO™ jersey that is cooling and naturally breathable ✨ Deep 6cm stretch waistband that smooths, flatters and never digs in 🧘 Wearer-tested waistband that will not roll, flip or slide down 👜 Deep side pockets for phone, keys and daily essentials 🔀 Relaxed drape with elasticated ankle cuffs for easy movement 👖 Looks smarter than sweats but feels just as comfy 🧼 Designed to last wash after wash without losing shape 📏 Inclusive sizing so every body is welcome 🌍 Ethically made in Turkey as part of a slow-fashion approach Every product in the Untamed Soul range is named in honour of someone who refused to accept the boundaries and limits that society put on them. These trousers are named after Claudette Colvin, who was just 15 years old when she refused to give up her seat to a white passenger on a segregated bus in Montgomery, Alabama—nine months before Rosa Parks did the same. Despite her bravery, civil rights leaders at the time felt an unmarried pregnant teenager wasn't the right face for the movement, so her story was largely pushed to the margins. We honour Claudette because she reminds us of the raw, unfiltered courage of youth and the uncomfortable truth that history often polishes away the edges of the people who actually started the fire.

title: Japanese Kawaii Influencer in Harajuku w/ Pastel Hair, Pink Hime Overalls, Decora Accessories, Starblinc Bag & Platform Sandals
sourceText: Haruka Kurebayashi is a name that needs no introduction to fans of kawaii Japanese fashion. She’s been a model, influencer, YouTuber, fashion designer, and all around kawaii ambassador for years, so we were very happy to see her on the street in Harajuku on the first weekend after the Tokyo lockdowns officially ended. Kurebayashi is wearing kawaii pink polka dot overalls with a big heart from Pink Hime over an H&M ruffle top, kawaii decora accessories from Wada Labo, an enamel handbag by the Japanese retro fashion brand Starblinc, and butterfly platform sandals. Kurebayashi’s favorite brands include Listen Flavor and Starblinc and she listens to the music of Melanie Martinez. Follow her on Twitter , Instagram or YouTube for more of her kawaii fashion and Tokyo life. Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese Fashion Designer in Handmade Moss-Covered Denim Dress & Tall Boots on the Street in Harajuku
sourceText: Airi is a 17-year-old Japanese fashion designer. She attends both Vantan Design Institute Tokyo and coconogacco fashion school. On this day in Harajuku, Airi was wearing a denim dress that she designed herself. It appears to be decorated with living moss, as well as being deconstructed. She’s also carrying a minimalist tote bag and wearing tall Demonia platform boots. For more information on Airi’s fashion design, check her personal Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Teddy Bear & Vintage Pink Harajuku Street Style w/ Twin Buns, Teddy Bear, Sweatshirt, Teddy Print Tulle Skirt, Polka Dot Belt, Pastel Flower Ring & Tokyo Bopper Bow Platforms
sourceText: Meet Akane, a Japanese art student who caught our eye with her all baby pink teddy street style. Sporting blonde twin buns and a pink face mask, Akane stepped out in a resale pink teddy bear sweatshirt, which she paired with a long teddy bear print skirt and a sheer tulle skirt overlay. To style her look, Akane cinched her waist with a pink polka dotted belt and also wore a pair of Tokyo Bopper platform shoes. She finished her kawaii look with hair pins to decorate her twin buns, a detachable lace collar, a pastel flower ring and a pink teddy bear stuffed toy. Kiki2 Koenji is Akane’s favorite fashion boutique and when it comes to music, she loves Japanese singer Kyary Pamyu Pamyu. Follow Akane on Instagram to see more of her style and check out her accessory shop on her website . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Harajuku Girl in Pink Kawaii Pretty Cure Anime Fashion w/ Pekorin Plush, Magical Girl Wand, Kuromi & Hello Kitty
sourceText: Pink-haired Akirameron has become a regular around the streets of Harajuku this year. When we spotted her this time, she was wearing a pink kawaii street style that included a DOKIDOKI! Precure (Pretty Cure) “Cure Heart” graphic anime t-shirt from Premium Bandai with a plaid skirt, plaid leg warmers, and Yosuke platform sandals. Her numerous accessories – some of which are from Apsanil and Q-pot – include hair decorations, a magical girl wand, necklaces and badges, a Kuromi face mask, a Precure Pekorin plush, Hello Kitty arm warmers, cute rings, and other items. Akirameron told us that Shiina Pikarin is her favorite performer and that she posts photos on both Twitter and Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese Idol’s Kawaii Street Style w/ Decora Accessories, Troll Earrings, Handmade Jacket, 6%DOKIDOKI, Yoshida Chanel, ACDC Rag Fuzzy Shorts & Candy Platforms
sourceText: Sporting an eye-catching, colorful streetwear style in Tokyo is Rikutama, a 19-year-old student and Rainbow Panic idol group member we bumped into. This evening, Rikutama stepped out in a handmade peach cropped pajama jacket over a white t-shirt and colorful fuzzy shorts from ACDC Rag. He wore the shorts over purple tights, wore pink ribbed socks and stepped into kawaii print platform boots from ACDC Rag. He topped off his look with colorful accessories such as a lip print headband, a striped hair bow, multiple decora clips, troll earrings, a pink lace choker, multicolored bead necklace, stacked bead bracelets and a striped rainbow belt. He also added multiple colorful rings. Most of his accessories are from Yoshida Channel and 6%DokiDoki. Rikutama lists ACDC Rag, WEGO and 6%DokiDoki as his favorite fashion brands and he enjoys the music of AKB48. For more of his streetwear looks, check out Rikutama on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Harajuku Girl in Colorful Fashion w/ Cat Face Mask, Current Mood California Dreamin’ Shorts & Tank, The Kawaii Shoppu Bag & YRU Platforms
sourceText: Easily standing out on the streets with her colorful rainbow look is 19-year-old art student and popular Harajuku street style personality Sierra. Sierra is wearing matching halter top and shorts with a colorful California Dreamin graphic print by Current Mood clothing. She styled her ensemble with a Kawaii Bun Bun Backpack from The Kawaii Shoppu and rainbow striped YRU platform shoes, which she wore with mismatched striped knee-high socks. To accessorize, Sierra donned a cat print face mask from Amazon, a multicolor headband, several Silly Bandz rubber bracelets, and a handmade beaded bracelet. She finished her look with cat eye makeup and pink dotted face makeup. According to Sierra, her favorite fashion brand is Hard Decora. Follow her on Instagram to see more of her personal style. title: Vintage Kimono, Torii Gate Headpiece & Lace Corset Japanese Street Style in Harajuku
sourceText: Kurage Geraku is a Japanese kimono-lover who we have been seeing around the streets of Harajuku for several years. Her look here features a vintage kimono worn with a black lace corset, vintage handbag, and Mode Kaori heeled loafers. Accessories – which include a shrine torii headpiece, a wooden necklace, a decorated mask, glow in the dark hair decorations, earrings, a large necklace, and silver rings – are by Wago (hair pin), Vivienne Westwood, Koku Bozu, and items handmade by her friends. Kurage Geraku posts her kimono meets modern fashion on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Pastel Harajuku Fairy Kei Street Style w/ Twin Tails, Spinns Sweater, Tiered Skirt, Uramo Bunny Bag, Nile Perch & Yosuke Platforms
sourceText: While out and about in Harajuku, 16-year-old Japanese student Sara caught our eye with her pastel street style. Sporting twin tails and a pink face mask, Sara stepped out wearing a Spinns sweater paired with a tiered pastel blue mini skirt. She styled her pastel outfit with an Uramo bunny handbag and white Yosuke platform shoes, which she wore with white leg warmers and stockings. Sara rounded up her look with several accessories from Kinji, Claire’s and Nile Perch. She wore pink headphones, a pink bow necklace, a star pin, button pin and a pink hearts belt. To add to that, she also wore decora rings, including a ribbon ring, a flower ring and a blue heart ring. Kiki2 and Spank! are Sara’s favorite brands. When it comes to music, she loves listening to Sekia No Owari and Judy and Mary. Follow Sara on Instagram to see more of her style. Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese Illustrator w/ Pastel Twin Tails In Silver Puffer Jacket, Printed Art Shirt, The North Face Extreme Fleece Pants, Candy Stripper Backpack, Claire’s Accessories & Demonia Platform Shoes
sourceText: Meet Yumi Yumi Yummy, a Japanese manga artist and illustrator who caught our eye with her colorful street style. Sporting twin tails in pastel blue and pastel green, Yumi stepped out wearing a metallic silver puffer jacket. Under her jacket, she is wearing a shirt with her own illustration printed on it. She paired this with a vintage The North Face Extreme fleece pants and Demonia platform shoes with Decora-style laces. To style her look, Yumi carried a Candy Stripper backpack and she also donned multiple accessories from Claire’s, including star dangling earrings, a game console necklace, clear goggles and several rings — a rainbow ring, twin hearts ring, yin yang ring, heart ring and a green alien ring. Yumi Yumi Yummy shared that she loves shopping vintage pieces and also at Claire’s. You can check out more of her art illustrations on her Instagram and Twitter . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: ACDC Rag Furry Pastel Jacket in Harajuku w/ Twin Buns, Rabbit Mask, Plushies, No Camera Perler Bead Necklace, Kawaii Print T-Shirt, EL Rodeo Smiley Pants, Daiso & Metallic Platform Sneakers
sourceText: Sporting an eye-catching kawaii streetwear look in Harajuku after dark is Purinchan, a Japanese idol (her group is Rainbow Panic) and popular figure in the Tokyo kawaii fashion scene. Purinchan stepped out in a rainbow pastel furry jacket from ACDC Rag, worn over a kawaii print t-shirt, also from ACDC Rag. She also wore tie-dyed cropped pants with smiley face prints from EL Rodeo and stepped into metallic silver platform sneakers from ACDC Rag to finish off her style. Purinchan topped off her colorful look with accessories including multiple decora hair clips, a rabbit face mask, a furry purple neck warmer, a No-Camera perler bead necklace with multicolored chains and a long checkered belt. Some of her accessories are handmade by Natti while some are from Daiso. She is also carrying a resale gold chain strap plushie bag with a couple of plushie keychains. In addition, she is also toting a cream-colored puppy head plushie. Japanese kawaii brand, 6%DokiDoki, is Purinchan’s favorite, and she loves listening to the tunes of Daoko. For Purinchan’s social media updates, follow her on Twitter and Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

sourceText: Kagetora is a 19-year-old Japanese student whose stunning hairstyle and monochrome fashion caught our eyes on the streets of Harajuku. In addition to his hairstyle, Kagetora is wearing a cropped blazer (it looks cut off) with a zipper front shirt by Fekete, black ripped Fekete pants decorated with safety pins, a snakeskin print shoulder bag by the Korean streetwear brand Open The Door, and boots. title: Japanese Trio’s Dark Harajuku Street Styles w/ Vampire Fangs, Spiked Chokers, Spider Ring, Azul by Moussy, Pink Latte, WEGO, Le Tanneur, Anap & Demonia Tall Boots
sourceText: Sporting eye-catching all black styles on Harajuku’s Cat Street one evening is this trio of teens. They are Keetaa, Rina and Yuu. At the left most side is Rina, a 17-year-old student. She is dressed in a black sweatshirt with purple flames print on each sleeve and black convertible pants, both of which are from Pink Latte. She finished off her style with heeled lace-up boots and accessorized with a furry beret, purple-tinted sunglasses and a silver pendant necklace, some of which are from WEGO. Rina is also sporting silver vampire fangs. She lists Azul by Moussy as her favorite brand and she enjoys listening to the music of Japanese idol group, Zoc. For more on Rina, follow her social media updates on Twitter and Instagram . Sporting a striking look at the middle is Keetaa, also a 17-year-old student. He stepped out in a black Azul by Moussy furry coat, which he wore over a dragon print scaled sleeveless shirt with a black mesh cowl scarf and black cut-off shorts with distressed cuffs. Keetaa stepped into a pair of Demonia tall patent leather buckle boots and carried a black crocodile leather handbag from Le Tanneur. He embellished his style with accessories such as black sunglasses with gold chain strap, a leather spiked choker, a white grommet belt, a black spider ring and silver knuckle rings. Keetaa’s fashion favorites include Chanel, Y’s and Issey Miyake and he loves listening to Creephyp. Keetaa is also active on Instagram . Meanwhile, Yuu’s outfit consists of a resale jacket, a long sleeve butterfly print shirt from Chucla and black flared pants from Anap. The 18-year-old student completed their ensemble with platform heeled boots from Anap and accessories such as red-tinted sunglasses, glass bead earrings, a black spiked leather choker, red lip-shaped sunglasses, a silver chain belt and an assortment of colorful knuckle rings. In addition, Yuu is carrying a resale chain-strap purse. Yuu enjoys listening to the music of Japanese punk rock band, The Blue Hearts. Follow Yuu’s streetwear looks on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese Gothic & Lolita Street Fashion w/ Edera+Peta-Peta Fish Headdress, Atelier Boz Matilda Dress, Chante Bird Cage Skirt, Triple Fortune & Metamorphose Temps De Fille Platforms
sourceText: Meet Sana Seine, a Japanese gothic lolita who is a well known personality in the Tokyo subculture fashion scene. We were lucky to meet Sana on the street in Harajuku. Sana styled her ombre gray and pink hair up into curly twin tails, which she accented with an Edera+peta-peta lolita lace headdress featuring a fish head and floral accents. She wore an Atelier Boz Matilda gothic and lolita one piece dress coat – a steampunk-inspired swing coat which features a jabot collar, a zippered front with vintage button accents, shoulder and side straps, and a tiered black dress panel at the back. She styled her coat dress with a black faux leather bird cage skirt from Chante, donned black Triple Fortune fishnets with embroidered details and stud accents and finished off her style with black platform doll shoes from Metamorphose Temps De Fille. Sana embellished her Japanese gothic lolita look with blue flower boutonnieres, a layered filigree cross charm necklace, and a bronze flower pendant necklace with matching rings. In addition, Sana is carrying a colorblocked leather satchel backpack with a cute pink plushie keychain. Japanese Lolita fashion brand, Atelier Boz, Triple Fortune and Nath are some of Sana’s fashion favorites. For more of her lolita streetwear looks, follow Sana on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Brazilian Tattoo Artist in Gothic Harajuku Street Style w/ Medusa Piercing, Cameo Jewelry, Graphic Dress, Alice and the Pirates, Angelic Pretty, Winged Heart Bag & Boots
sourceText: Easily catching our attention in Tokyo is Beatriz, a Brazilian tattoo artist based in Tokyo. This afternoon, orange-haired Beatriz stepped out sporting a gothic look. Her style features an asymmetric chiffon vest – bought in China – and layered with a sheer black lace camisole top from Alice and the Pirates. She also wore a print dress with sheer black sleeves and ruffled lace hem trims, also bought in China. Sheer black polka dot socks, pointy lace-up ankle boots from Reversa and an Alice and the Pirates heart-shaped bag with bat wings rounded out her look. Beatriz embellished her style with a black wide brim hat with sheer fabric and feather trims from Angelic Pretty and accessories such as dangling fishbone earrings, a gold cross necklace, a cameo cuff bracelet, a multi-strand pearl bracelet and a couple of brass knuckle rings. Some of her accessories are from China while some are handmade and antique/vintage pieces. Beatriz lists Angelic Pretty, Sheglit and Vivienne Westwood as her fashion favorites and she enjoys the music of Japanese rock band, Buck-Tick and heavy-metal band, Dir En Grey. Check out Beatriz on Instagram and on her official website . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese Shironuri Artist Minori in Dark Remake Harajuku Style w/  Black Lace Mask, Veiled Headdress, Brocade Dress & Platform Boots
sourceText: Standing out on the streets of Tokyo with her all black remake street style fashion is Minori, the popular Japanese Shironuri artist we’ve featured many times on our Harajuku street snaps. This afternoon, Minori – sporting an ash gray bob – is clad in a remake and handmade ensemble. She is dressed in a remake brocade dress featuring a deep V neckline and silk puffed sleeves with ruffle & tasseled cuffs. She also wore a black inner top, black tights and a long sheer black skirt with fringed lace hem trims over her dress. In addition, the artist is carrying a velvet round box bag with a rope strap, bead trims and gold sun, moon, stars accents. Check out Minori’s statement-making fashion styles on Instagram . title: Japanese Clown-Inspired Street Style in Harajuku w/ Hello Kitty, Shironuri Makeup & Room Shoes
sourceText: 20-year-old Japanese beauty school student Rikito wearing a clown inspired style on the street in Harajuku, Tokyo. This street snap was shot on Rikito’s 20th birthday and he was wearing all vintage/resale fashion, a Hello Kitty with a face (that appears to be burned in), and Japanese room shoes. Rikito has become well-known in the Harajuku street style scene this year as a result of his very original sense of style. Rikito often combines kimono, geta, and traditional Japanese fashion elements with a mix of more modern resale/vintage fashion pieces (sometimes from vintage shops, sometimes borrowed from his mom) along with shironuri makeup influenced by everything from manga to Japanese history and classic French mimes. While Rikito’s favorite fashion designer is Japanese legend Yohji Yamamoto, he doesn’t generally wear brand clothing. Follow Rikito on Instagram for more of his style and beauty school life in Tokyo. Click on any photo to enlarge it.

When we ran into Airi this time, she was wearing a custom headpiece by Rou-chan with a striped Armani jacket over a sailor top, wide cutoff pants that she made herself with a large belt and belt buckle, a vintage metal necklace, a white plush seal, a bag by Kagari Yusuki, and vintage 1990s platform boots with velcro straps. Airi told us that her favorite fashion designers right now include Tiscar Espadas and Les Six. You can see her fashion design and follow her Tokyo life on Instagram and Twitter . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese “Denim Man” Street Style w/ Handmade Jeans Outfit & Denim Mask in Harajuku
sourceText: 21-year-old Japanese Bunka Fashion College student and aspiring designer Haruki wearing a handmade “whole body denim man” look on the street in Harajuku Tokyo. Haruki is known for making his own clothes and for his love of denim, both of which are on display here. This look includes a handmade miniature denim jacket full head mask (he can see out, look for his eyes in the closeup), with matching tiny denim pants worn as a necklace, a remake jacket with entire jeans for each arm, a vintage top customized with numerous belts (maintaining the jeans theme), a crossbody bag in the shape of jeans shorts (see closeup), wide leg remake denim pants that use a full pair of pants for each leg (matching the sleeves of his jacket), and vintage boots. Haruki also told us that his favorite band is Nirvana. He has an account for his own brand on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Harajuku Mother & Daughter w/ The Ivy Tokyo Earrings, Sailor Moon, fäfä, Sister Jane & Mikio Sakabe
sourceText: We have been street snapping fashionable mother daughter duo Tsumire and Ivy in Harajuku since before 7-year-old Ivy was even born! We were very happy to run into them again outside of a Harajuku pop event that Tsumire’s accessory brand The Ivy Tokyo participated in. Tsumire – a Taiwanese fashion designer based in Tokyo – is wearing a belted Dream Sister Jane jacquard dress with a vintage belt from Ameri VINTAGE, a Vivienne Westwood necklace, a headpiece and earrings by her own brand The Ivy Tokyo, graphic tights, and Grounds sneakers by Japanese designer Mikio Sakabe. Ivy is wearing a ruffle dress by the Tokyo based children’s fashion brand fäfä with a Sailor Moon bag and Jelly shoes. The last photo in the set shows another Tokyo-based designer, Etsuna Otsuka , and her family with the Tsumire and Ivy. Ivy’s favorite fashion brand is Vivienne Westwood and she listens to the music of Bes and Kimetsu No Yaiba. For more of Ivy’s fashion, follow her on Instagram . Take a look at Tsumire’s Instagram for more mother-and-daughter fashion styles. Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Japanese Idol w/ Tattoos & Piercings Wearing Sheer Fashion & Boots in Harajuku
sourceText: Hakua-Gozen is a Japanese idol in the group Tokyo Psychopath as well as being a tattoo model. When we met Hakua-Gozen on the street in Harajuku, she was wearing a vintage crop top and top she bought online with arm covers, a sheer skirt from H&M, rings, and patent boots. Her numerous tattoos and piercings are a major part of her look, including giant butterfly wings on her back and tattoo artwork on her neck, legs, and the back of each of her hands. Hakua-Gozen’s favorite fashion brand is Mukzin and she likes the music of The Kills and St. Vincent. For more on her music, tattoos, and fashion, follow her on Instagram or Twitter . Her group is Tokyo Psychopath . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Yohji Yamamoto Pour Homme Monochrome Menswear Style w/ Shaved Head, Long Cardigan, Minimalist Jewelry, Loewe Leather Clutch & Onitsuka Tiger Sneakers
sourceText: Sporting a minimalist monochrome look on the streets of Harajuku one afternoon is Yuha, a 29-year-old office worker. Yuha is dressed in a Yohji Yamamoto Pour Homme outfit consisting of a long black cardigan with rolled-up sleeves, a plain white t-shirt with side slits and black wide leg pants. Onitsuga Tiger leather sneakers in a black-and-white colorway and minimalist jewelry such as a single hoop earring, a black leather-strap smart watch, an engraved silver cuff bracelet and a silver ring capped off his style. His accessories are from Jil Sander, Garni and Love Mars. In addition, Yuha is carrying a black leather clutch from Loewe. Yohji Yamamoto, Attachment, Cullni and Jil Sander are some of Yuha’s favorite fashion brands. Meanwhile, his top musical artist/group picks are Tokyo Jihen, Arch Enemy, Chapin and X-Japan. Follow Yuha’s social media updates on Twitter and his minimalist aesthetic style feed on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

title: Tokyo Rainbow Streetwear Style w/ Multicolored Hair Falls, Colorful Balls, ACDC Rag, That Rainbow Chick Horns, Aika Electronics, 6%DokiDoki, Claire’s Tulle Skirt, Spencer’s Gifts, WEGO, Daiso, Kawaii Monster Cafe, Gloomy Monster, Kol Me Baby & Platforms
sourceText: As we were walking along the streets of Harajuku, we came across Dolly, the English teacher, designer and street style personality we’ve often featured in our street snaps section. Dolly stepped out in multicolored braided yarn and cyber hair falls in addition to her rainbow fashion. She is dressed in an ACDC Rag candy print jacket, a yellow mesh top from 6%DokiDoki over a kawaii print top and bottom layers consisting of a pink ACDC Rag pleated skirt, a rainbow tutu and tulle skirt from Claire’s, rainbow fishnet tights and furry rainbow leg warmers from Spencer’s Gifts. She finished off her outfit with candy print platform shoes from ACDC Rag and a furry rainbow waist bag from Kol Me Baby. For her head accessories, Dolly wore a kawaii mini top hat headpiece from Aika Electronics, a That Rainbow Chick blue horns headband along with multiple hair clips from 6%DokiDoki, Claire’s, Daiso and WEGO. Other accessories include a candy print face mask, a 6%DokiDoki ice cream necklace, a button necklace, an ACDC Rag fuzzy collar, multicolored hanging balls, stacked bracelets, fuzzy fingerless gloves and a couple of Aika Electronics rings. In addition, Dolly is sporting a colorful makeup and carrying Kawaii Monster Cafe plushie keychains and a Gloomy Bear monster plushie. Popular Japanese kawaii streetwear brand, ACDC Rag, is Dolly’s fashion favorite and she loves listening to Miyavi. Follow Dolly on Instagram , Twitter and on her official website, That Rainbow Chick . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

Sporting a long ombre pink hairstyle with braided accents, Izzy stepped out in a black bodysuit from Wolford with pink harness trims and a pair of pink-and-silver metallic platform boots from Be Fierce. They accessorized with a white Be Fierce face harness, a pink handmade mask, a clear corset with white leather trims, and a handmade white leather body harness. Izzy’s favorite fashion label is Namilia, and they like the music of Grimes. For more of their streetwear looks, follow Izzy on Instagram . Click on any photo to enlarge it.

sourceText: This coat is our latest obsession! Now in Lavender! This flouncy number has detachable bunny ears and a frilly, ruffly trim at the collar and hem. title: Basics Biker Shorts - Lavender
sourceText: My Violet Basics are our newest line of buildable layering items that are designed to be easy to thrown on over or under anything!  Stretchy, adjustable, and breathable, all items are made with comfort in mind and are extremely sensory-friendly. title: Peropero Sparkles Skort
sourceText: Our ultimate dream collab; PeroPero Sparkles is a cute trio of glittery eyed aliens created by japanese artist Yurie Sekiya.
